modules.description: Defines provider defaults, runtime configuration, prompt templates, and animation constants.
interactions: Provides shared settings to provider, context, API, and UI modules.

modules.description: Defines curated free and local provider model entries.
interactions: ProviderRegistry merges these curated entries with discovered provider models.

modules.description: Discovers free model catalogs through userscript cross-origin requests.
interactions: ProviderRegistry runs the adapters in parallel and normalizes their model entries.

modules.description: Caches, normalizes, filters, and merges curated and discovered model entries.
interactions: Settings UI reads cached entries synchronously; ProviderManager resolves pins against the registry.

modules.description: Isolates Prompt Enhancer events and UI behavior from the host chat page.
interactions: Installed during bootstrap and used by UI modules that mount elements on host pages.

modules.description: Provides shared DOM, text, timing, identifier, and formatting helpers.
interactions: Used across context, composer, UI, and orchestration modules.

modules.description: Provides UI internationalization helpers and dictionaries.
interactions: UI modules consume t() for localized strings.

modules.description: Stores and applies the interface theme preference (auto, light, or dark).
interactions: Bootstrap applies the stored theme; settings and menu commands change it; styles.js reads the data-pe-theme attribute.

modules.description: Defines the SiteAdapter contract, defaults, and factory for platform adapters.
interactions: SiteAdapterRegistry consumes SiteAdapter.create and defaults to build concrete adapters.

modules.description: Resolves the active SiteAdapter by location with deterministic order and generic fallback.
interactions: Providers and Composer consume the registry to obtain the active adapter.

modules.description: Detects chat providers and manages project-context files and prompt suffixes.
interactions: Composer and settings UI use ProjectContext; ApiClient uses provider detection and context wrapping.

modules.description: Migrates legacy settings and enhancement history into the current storage format.
interactions: Bootstrap runs migrations before loading current application state.

modules.description: Stores provider configurations and resolves the active provider and fallback.
interactions: Settings UI pins catalog routes; ApiClient resolves them while retaining legacy provider settings.

modules.description: Classifies network and provider failures and maintains error history.
interactions: ApiClient reports failures; orchestration and UI use classified messages and actions.

modules.description: Persists enhancement runs, nested API calls, outcomes, and history limits.
interactions: Orchestration creates and updates runs while ApiClient records their individual calls.

modules.description: Limits API request frequency independently for each host.
interactions: ApiClient checks the limiter before sending requests.

modules.description: Defines generation parameter fields, presets, defaults, validation, and storage.
interactions: Settings UI edits parameters; orchestration passes cleaned values to ApiClient.

modules.description: Validates, stores, and manages the base system prompt and user presets.
interactions: Settings UI manages prompts; ApiClient composes them into requests.

modules.description: Parses streamed responses and provides animation helpers with reduced-motion support.
interactions: ApiClient consumes StreamParser; overlays and previews use Anim.

modules.description: Draws and updates the loading gear used by the progress overlay.
interactions: Molecules creates gear instances for loading UI.

modules.description: Injects the stylesheet for all Prompt Enhancer UI components.
interactions: Bootstrap injects these styles before mounting interface components.

modules.description: Defines reusable SVG icons and primitive buttons and controls.
interactions: Molecules, settings, and context interfaces use these shared UI primitives.

modules.description: Handles code text and file attachments used by guided enhancement.
interactions: Guided-mode UI collects attachments and passes their content to ApiClient.

modules.description: Provides the anchored interface for loading and managing project-context files.
interactions: Composer opens the popover; ProjectContext stores files later consumed by ApiClient.

modules.description: Holds shared runtime state for the active composer, requests, and UI.
interactions: Composer, settings, and orchestration read and update the same state object.

modules.description: Renders application settings and hosts Projects Main to project-scoped Workspace navigation.
interactions: Molecules exposes the modal; orchestration receives saved values and applies them to runtime state.
Projects Main owns project discovery and selection; Workspace operates on the selected project only.
Preserves per-project Workspace sessions while the shared modal remains open.

modules.description: Connects API progress events to the loading overlay state and display.
interactions: Orchestration wires ApiClient events to overlays created by Molecules.

modules.description: Composes reusable UI components including toolbars, overlays, previews, and wizards.
interactions: Composer mounts its toolbar; orchestration coordinates the overlays, preview, wizard, and notifications.

modules.description: Extracts, normalizes, and compares code anchors (identifiers, URLs, placeholders) across original and enhanced prompts.
interactions: Used by output-validator to detect lost anchors between original text and model output.

modules.description: Builds provider requests, composes prompts and context, and handles streaming and retries.
interactions: Orchestration supplies user input and settings; ApiClient records nested calls and emits progress events.
Receives pre-composed read-only Workspace context from orchestration and adds it to the system prompt.

modules.description: Detects supported chat inputs and mounts the enhancement toolbar for each composer.
interactions: Connects host-page inputs to toolbar actions handled by orchestration.

modules.description: Coordinates direct and guided enhancement flows, requests, overlays, previews, and errors.
interactions: Receives Composer actions and coordinates ApiClient, history, settings, and result interfaces.
Resolves evidence from the selected project for direct and guided enhancement before calling ApiClient.

modules.description: Deterministic output validator that detects lost anchors, language/script changes, and meta comments in model responses.
interactions: Used by orchestration and ApiClient.enhance to validate model outputs before applying them.

modules.description: Repair handler with a ceiling of 1 attempt. Tracks violations and allows at most one repair pass.
interactions: Used by orchestration to limit repair attempts when validation fails.

modules.description: Defines workspace project and file identifiers, defaults, and safe relative path normalization.
interactions: ProjectManager and FileRegistry use the shared models and path rules.

modules.description: Persists workspace projects and project files in IndexedDB with transactional project deletion.
interactions: ProjectManager and FileRegistry use this adapter without depending on IndexedDB details.

modules.description: Creates, lists, retrieves, updates, and deletes persistent workspace projects.
interactions: Workspace facade exposes project lifecycle operations to future UI and AI services.

modules.description: Validates and manages text files belonging to a project, including metadata and content.
interactions: Workspace facade exposes project-scoped file operations; content remains outside prompt composition until explicitly requested.

modules.description: Persistent project folder operations with path validation and atomic subtree mutations.
interactions: Workspace exposes FolderRegistry through Workspace.folders.

modules.description: Provides the public Workspace facade, initialization lifecycle, and UI-controlled active project selection.
interactions: Future workspace UI, project context, and AI tools consume this stable facade.
Settings UI selects the active project; ContextResolver reads project content through the facade.

modules.description: Builds a normalized in-memory directory index and flattened visible rows for Workspace files.
interactions: Explorer view consumes sorted directory nodes and flattened visible rows; directories remain derived from file paths.

modules.description: Renders the Workspace file explorer with persistent folder expansion, path search, keyboard navigation and threshold-based row virtualization.
interactions: Workspace UI passes file metadata, selected file ID and selection callbacks; the view never accesses persistence or mutates Workspace data.

modules.description: Owns the Workspace editor surface, controls and editor-specific DOM lifecycle.
interactions: The Workspace UI supplies save/delete and panel-toggle callbacks; the editor view does not access Workspace persistence.

modules.description: Coordinates Workspace file creation and import workflows through the public Workspace facade.
interactions: UI delegates batch creation, folder initialization and text-file import; the controller validates inputs and commits through Workspace.files.createMany().

modules.description: Composes contextual Workspace permissions and project settings into a collapsible inspector panel.
interactions: The UI supplies existing settings sections and close behavior; the inspector owns only panel presentation and visibility.

modules.description: Provides an accessible, bounded resizable explorer/editor split.
interactions: Workspace UI owns the layout composition and inserts the separator; this module handles pointer and keyboard resizing.

modules.description: Provides the dedicated Projects Main interface for searching, sorting, creating, renaming, deleting, and opening projects.
interactions: Settings modal mounts Projects Main and keeps its view state while a project Workspace is active.
All project reads and mutations use the public Workspace facade.

modules.description: Scoped production stylesheet ported from the approved workspace mock.
interactions: WorkspaceMockUI injects the stylesheet when a project workspace is mounted.

modules.description: Mock-faithful project workspace view bound to persistent project, folder, file, provider, permission, and settings domains.
interactions: WorkspaceUI delegates its public render contract to WorkspaceMockUI.
All project, folder, file, permission, provider, import, and configuration operations use the existing domain facades.

modules.description: Provides the operational editor interface for one selected project.
interactions: Preserves the WorkspaceUI.render(container, options) contract consumed by settings-modal.

modules.description: Finds relevant project files and excerpts for a prompt using local lexical search and read-only AI access permissions.
interactions: Prompt context composition consumes ranked excerpts and diagnostics; the resolver only reads authorized project files and never mutates Workspace data.

modules.description: Formats authorized Workspace resolution results into bounded, deterministic prompt context.
interactions: Prompt assembly consumes project instructions and ranked file excerpts; the composer only formats data and never accesses or mutates Workspace.

modules.description: Starts the application, restores state, registers host observers, and wires menu commands.
interactions: Runs after all modules are concatenated and initializes the shared application interfaces.
Initializes the persistent workspace subsystem without blocking the existing application startup.
